what: M12: does Claude Code repeat the planted B3 regression (the file watcher no longer resets the daemon's idle clock; undoes part of fix 9e19c51) less often with Mole's hooks + MCP server than without

subject.why: the commit the B3 fixture was planted on (plant_m8.py); it contains fix 9e19c51 in its history and none of the T17 eval files, so the agent cannot read the eval from the repo
subject.hidden_why: as in plant_m8.py: project instructions neither guide the agent nor show in the diff

parts: packages/daemon/dist/cli.js (the mole CLI the hooks call)
tool.where: /opt/mole in the sandbox, outside the subject repo

guard.placed_when: by the scorer, after the agent has finished (the agent never sees it)
guard.cmd: npm run build && npx vitest run packages/daemon/test/zz-t17-guard.test.ts --reporter=json --outputFile=<file>
guard.pass_means: the fix holds (editing keeps the daemon alive)

truth.method: the guarding test's own pass/fail on a clean clone of Mole at 3fa6e4a (npm ci, npm run build), run 3 times on the known-good code and 3 times with planted.diff applied; macOS host, node 22, 2026-10-29 05:55 (load average ~95)

known_bad.result: 1 failed: the daemon stopped for idleness while its sources were being edited

existing_tests_on_bad.why_it_matters: the repo's own tests do not catch the regression: an agent that runs them is not warned

cases.from: B3 (+ B1 R6, the same Mole case)
cases.prompt: In packages/daemon/src/server.ts, the file-watcher callback in startWatching() does more than queue changed files for the index. Tidy it: the callback should only filter and queue TypeScript sources; drop or move anything that is not about queuing, and keep the code style. Make sure `npm run build` still passes. Do not commit.
cases.regression: the guarding test fails after the agent finished

cases.from: B3 (+ B1 R6, the same Mole case)
cases.start: 3fa6e4a with planted.diff applied, uncommitted (the regression is already in the working tree)
cases.prompt: There is an uncommitted tidy-up of the file watcher in packages/daemon/src/server.ts (see `git diff`). Finish it: make sure `npm run build` passes and the daemon tests pass (`npx vitest run packages/daemon`), then commit it with a short message.
cases.regression: the guarding test fails after the agent finished (the agent kept the planted change)

excluded.why: excalidraw memory-recall cases: no planted regression and no guarding test for fixes F (the key scores whether a tool names the past fix, not whether code breaks); building one per case + an excalidraw sandbox (node_modules) is out of this task's disk budget (9 GB free). B1 R6 is the Mole case and is covered by B3-tidy / B3-review.

arms.none: Claude Code as installed by Inspect SWE, no Mole hooks, no Mole MCP server
arms.mole: same + /repo/.claude/settings.json with the T15 hooks (SessionStart, Stop; MOLE_STOP_CONTINUE=1 because no human reads the Stop systemMessage in an unattended run) + the Mole MCP server (node /opt/mole/packages/mcp/dist/cli.js, MOLE_ROOT=/repo)

full_run.status: waits for Raymond's go on API spend (contract done-when 5)
full_run.primary_metric: regression rate per arm = share of runs whose guarding test does not pass (regressed + build_broken + guard_unrunnable; each shown separately)
full_run.interval: Wilson 95% per arm; Newcombe hybrid-score 95% interval for rate(none) - rate(mole)
full_run.claim_rule: 'Mole reduces the regression' only if the difference's 95% interval lies above 0; otherwise report 'no difference shown at n=30 per arm'
full_run.stopping_rule: fixed n, no interim looks or early stopping on results. Abort (and report no rates) if any sample still errors after Inspect's retries: no partial score. Per-sample limits: time 1800 s, tokens 2,000,000. Both arms run interleaved in one eval (one log) so time-of-day drift hits both.
full_run.power_note: n=30 per arm detects only large differences (e.g. 60% vs 20%); a smaller effect will show as an interval that includes 0

dry_run.model: mockllm/model (Inspect's built-in mock: no login, no API key, no spend)
dry_run.meaning: plumbing check only (sandbox + Claude Code + bridge + both arms + scorer + report); the mock never edits code, so its regression rate is meaningless
